text.content:
A strongroom whose door was clearly built to keep goblins out of goblin things - which makes it funny that its current contents are betting slips. Sacks of grain and a few genuinely valuable trinkets line the walls, but every flat surface is covered in wagers, all on the same subject.

GM Notes

Substory beat: Two rival war-chiefs, Grull and Nak, have agreed to settle a long-running feud with a llama race down the Larders' main hall. Both have independently tried to bribe the same racer, a fast, foul-tempered llama named Spitfire, into throwing the race for them - and both know the other is doing the same, which has only made both bribes larger. The vault's "treasure" is largely unclaimed wager stakes.

Subquest - Fixing the Race: If the party wants in: Spitfire will happily take a bribe from them too, third-partying the whole scheme, and the eventual race (staged wherever you like - the Room 17/18 corridor spine works well) can pay out however is funniest. Grull and Nak both showing up to the finish line and immediately blaming each other for cheating is the intended outcome regardless of who actually wins.
